subject: Arte
description_pt: Exercitar a imitação e o faz de conta, ressignificando objetos e fatos e experimentando-se no lugar do outro, ao compor e encenar acontecimentos cênicos, por meio de músicas, imagens, textos ou outros pontos de partida, de forma intencional e reflexiva.

components.description_pt: Praticar imitação para reinterpretar objetos ou eventos da perspectiva de outro
components.description_en: Practice imitation to reinterpret objects or events from another's perspective
components.cc_component_description: Compare how the same event might be described differently from another point of view

components.description_pt: Compor situações teatrais utilizando música, imagens, textos ou outros pontos de partida
components.description_en: Compose theatrical situations using music, images, texts, or other starting points

components.description_pt: Encenar situações teatrais de forma intencional e reflexiva
components.description_en: Stage theatrical situations in an intentional and reflective manner
components.cc_component_description: Explain how stage directions or descriptions in a drama are reflected in an oral performance

components.description_pt: Engajar-se em faz-de-conta colocando-se na perspectiva de outro durante brincadeira teatral
components.description_en: Engage in make-believe by placing oneself in another's perspective during theatrical play
components.cc_component_description: Build on others' ideas during collaborative discussions while clearly expressing one's own perspective

cc_matches.description: Describe how a narrator's or speaker's point of view influences how events are described.
Make connections between the text of a story or drama and a visual or oral presentation of the text, identifying where each version reflects specific descriptions and directions in the text.

Engage effectively in a range of collaborative discussions (one-on-one, in groups, and teacher-led) with diverse partners on grade 8 topics, texts, and issues, building on others' ideas and expressing their own clearly.
